name: continuity
description: A live context gauge and session length above the prompt; past a threshold it writes a handover note, compacts at the end of the turn and continues from the note, and it resumes after a 5-hour limit resets.

threshold.title: Handover at (% of context)
threshold.description: When the context fill reaches this percentage at the end of a turn, write the handover note, compact, and continue

resumeAfterLimit.title: Continue after the 5-hour limit resets
resumeAfterLimit.description: When a turn stops at the 5-hour usage limit, wait for the reset and continue by itself (a countdown shows while blocked)
